title: Introduce compliance runbook hooks, RBAC v2 policy hinting and KMS escrow router
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds runbook hooks for compliance incidents, RBAC v2 policy hinting in the Console, and a KMS escrow routing shim. Opt-in behind `feature.compliance.runbook_hooks` and `feature.kms.escrow_routing`. Non-breaking for existing tenants.
body:
Motivation: Customers and internal compliance teams asked for a lightweight way to (1) attach an executable runbook identifier to anomalous audit entries, (2) help security engineers author RBAC v2 policies with suggestions and examples, and (3) route KMS requests to an escrow provider when geographic residency constraints prevent the primary KMS from being used. This change bundles three coordinated pieces: runbook hooks, RBAC hinting, and a KMS escrow router.

Design summary: - Runbook hooks: a new internal/compliance/runbook_hooks.go subsystem that consumes decision traces from the policy engine and appends a structured runbook_id and playbook metadata to audit envelopes when configured. Hooks are pluggable and emit a compact JSON blob to the audit pipeline so downstream incident systems can open the correct runbook automatically.
- RBAC v2 policy hinting: a small suggestion engine (internal/rbac/hint_generator.go) that scans policy attempts and provides template suggestions surfaced in the Console (console/frontend/src/rbac/PolicyHintPanel.tsx). Hints are generated server-side and cached TTL=5m; the Console shows contextual examples and one-click apply to a draft policy.
- KMS escrow router: pkg/kms/escrow_router.go implements a routing policy that selects an escrow KMS endpoint when residency or CMK location constraints are detected. The router performs a fast residency-check lookup (with a 100ms cache) and emits an audit tag kms.escrow_used=true when escrowing occurs. The router is pluggable and guarded by feature flag `feature.kms.escrow_routing`.

Configuration & rollout: - Both runbook hooks and KMS escrow routing are behind feature flags: feature.compliance.runbook_hooks and feature.kms.escrow_routing. By default flags are disabled for all tenants; platform operators can enable per-tenant via the Console and Helm values (deploy/helm/values-compliance.yaml). RBAC hinting is enabled in beta for internal orgs only.
- Migration plan: No schema migration required. Audit envelopes get a new optional field `runbook_id` and `runbook_meta` when the hook is enabled; consumers ignoring unknown fields will be unaffected. The KMS router adds an audit tag but does not change encryption contexts.

Backwards compatibility and safety: - All additions are additive to audit envelopes. - KMS escrow routing uses a safe-fallback: if the escrow endpoint is unreachable, the router falls back to the primary KMS and emits a warning metric and audit entry. Operators can enable strict-escrow mode to enforce hard-fail behavior (not default).

Testing: - Unit tests added for hint generator and escrow router (tests/unit/rbac_hint_test.go, tests/unit/escrow_router_test.go). - Integration test that exercises feature flag on/off and ensures audit envelope contains expected runbook fields (tests/integration/compliance_runbook_test.go). - Console E2E test verifying the PolicyHintPanel UI and one-click apply flow added to console/tests/e2e/policy_hint.spec.ts.

Observability & alerts: - New metrics: compliance.runbook.hook.invocations, rbac.hints.generated, kms.escrow.fallbacks. - Dashboards: Compliance > Runbook Hooks (observability-pack/dashboards/runbook-hooks.json). - Alerts: kms.escrow.fallback_rate > 1% sustained 5m triggers SLO-review runbook.

Commits (high-level): 1) add: internal/compliance/runbook_hooks.go + basic wiring (commit f3a4c9d) 2) add: pkg/kms/escrow_router.go + router unit tests (commit a9b2f1c) 3) add: internal/rbac/hint_generator.go + console wiring + UI panel (commit c4d5e6a) 4) docs: docs/compliance/runbooks.md + helm values + test additions (commit d2e3f4b)

Files changed (high-level): - internal/compliance/runbook_hooks.go - internal/rbac/hint_generator.go - pkg/kms/escrow_router.go - console/frontend/src/rbac/PolicyHintPanel.tsx - console/frontend/tests/e2e/policy_hint.spec.ts - docs/compliance/runbooks.md - deploy/helm/values-compliance.yaml - tests/integration/compliance_runbook_test.go - tests/unit/{rbac_hint_test.go, escrow_router_test.go}

CI & Checks: - First CI run: unit tests pass, lint failed (Console lint rule: no-direct-dom-manipulation). Author fixed the Console lint in commit c4d5e6a. - Second CI run: all checks green (build, unit tests, console-e2e smoke). - Security review: SEC checklist completed and sign-off by Marisol Ortega.

Review conversation (summary): - Daniel Kim: requested that runbook_id be limited to 64 chars and added a guard and unit test (addressed). - Marisol Ortega: asked for explicit telemetry for escrow fallbacks and a Prometheus counter (added). - Jacob Li: questioned endurance under high QPS; author added a small batching cache for residency lookups and benchmark results in docs. - QA: flagged flaky e2e, author increased Selenium timeouts and stabilized the selector.

Risk assessment: Low-medium. The most risk is misrouting KMS under tight latencies; router includes timeouts, circuit-breaker, and a metric to detect regressions. Rollout should start with internal tenants and a canary percent on production.

Follow-ups (tracked in ENG-4642): - Add an operator-level UI for runbook management and runbook templates. - Expand RBAC hinting to suggest least-privilege edits automatically (UX research). - Add a policy to allow tenants to opt-out of escrow behavior at a per-route level.

Merge: Squash-and-merge after green CI and two approvals. Merge commit f3a4c9d7 recorded.
comments: Daniel Kim (reviewer): Please ensure runbook_id truncation does not collide; suggest using a 8-bytes CRC suffix. Author: added CRC suffix and unit test.
Marisol Ortega (security): Add counter for kms.escrow.fallbacks and a sentinel log line. Author: added metric and clarified audit tag semantics.
Jacob Li (sre): Can this cause extra latency in the hot path? Author: added a 100ms residency cache and stressed benchmark in docs; recommend canary rollout.
QA: e2e was flaky on CI due to tight timing; extended selector wait to 10s and re-ran. CI now green.
